name: jev-router
description: Asks Jev before each prompt what the task is and how hard it is, then picks the Claude model (and optionally effort) and the skill that fit. A control bar sets the quality/cost focus.

deepModel.title: Model for the deepest tier
deepModel.description: Which model handles tasks Jev rates as deep (architecture, security, hard debugging).

skillHints.title: Skill hints
skillHints.description: Tell Claude which installed skill Jev thinks fits the prompt.

effortRouting.title: Effort routing
effortRouting.description: Also set reasoning effort by tier: routine → medium, complex → high, deep → xhigh (Haiku takes none). Off keeps your session's effort.

focus.title: Starting focus
focus.description: Quality/cost trade-off until you move the bar's slider: token-efficient, lean, balanced, thorough or task-focused.

focusBar.title: Control bar
focusBar.description: Show the jev-router bar above the prompt (focus slider, toggles, model nudge).
